Name: Princess Alice of Albany
Notes: She married Prince Alexander of Teck on 10 February 1904. They had three children.

Name: Prince Charles Edward, Duke of Albany
Notes: Born four months after his father's death; known as 'Charlie'; Leopold Charles Edward George Albert; later reigning Duke of Saxe-Coburg-Gotha. He married Princess Victoria Adelaide of Schleswig-Holstein on 11 October 1905. They had five children.
